description:
Location: Remote (Greater Toronto Area)

Employment Type: Full time

Location Type: Remote

Department: Solutions & Delivery

Vantage is looking for a Director, Customer Support and Enablement (CSE) to lead our support and enablement team within Solutions & Delivery. Reporting to the VP of Solutions & Delivery, you will own service reliability and platform adoption for our enterprise retail media partners. You'll set the strategy for support and enablement, hire and develop the team, own the operating metrics, and partner with your peers in Account Management, Launch, Ad Operations, Product and Engineering. Your goal is that every retailer and brand gets fast, reliable help and keeps getting more value from Vantage after go-live.

You need to have built or owned a support function and managed teams in SaaS or ad tech. You fix the pattern, not just the ticket, and you enjoy building and refining the processes a growing team relies on. You champion a consistently great client experience at every touchpoint.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Define the CSE charter, service catalog and operating model, including what CSE owns, what it supports, and where it hands off to Account Management, Launch and Ad Operations.

  • Run a pooled service model: one shared queue and cross-training so PTO or attrition never leaves an account uncovered.

  • Build a multi-year plan for headcount, coverage and tooling as we add retail partners and regions, and plan staffing, schedules and coverage so service levels hold through growth.

  • Build a team culture that owns problems end to end, documents what it learns, and treats every ticket as a chance to prevent the next one.

  • Set and report on SLAs, time-to-resolution, backlog and quality standards for platform tickets, and own ticket triage, escalation paths and runbooks across all accounts.

  • Lead Sev-0/1 incident communications and make sure every one gets a root-cause analysis (RCA) shared with clients and internal teams.

  • Partner with Ad Operations on a clear coverage model for urgent and after-hours issues.

  • Lead client training, demos, FAQs and platform-change communications after launch, and own the Help Center (FreshDesk setup, articles, guides and publishing), built to reduce ticket volume.

  • Monitor feature adoption after launch and escalate low usage to the Account Manager and Product. Own weekly pacing, campaign and advertiser reporting, plus monthly ticket-trend reporting.

  • Partner with Launch and Account Management to ensure every new partner is set up for success, with a smooth transition from launch into ongoing support.

  • Own decisions on the support stack (FreshDesk, Jira and related tools) and the data flowing between them.

  • Run feature-request intake, turn ticket trends into prioritized input for Product and Engineering, and partner with Product on supportability reviews so new features are ready for clients before release.

  • Use AI and automation to raise team capacity without lowering quality.

  • Work as a peer to the Account Management, Launch and Ad Operations leaders on shared outcomes like account health, renewals and launch quality, and bring support and adoption data into QBRs and executive conversations with our largest retail partners.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in customer support, customer success, technical account management or platform operations in SaaS or ad tech.

  • 3+ years managing teams, including hiring, performance management and career development.

  • A track record of building or managing a support function: charter, SLAs, escalation paths, runbooks and reporting.

  • Hands-on experience running a support stack (FreshDesk, Zendesk or similar, plus Jira) and making tooling decisions.

  • Experience leading major incident communications and RCAs with enterprise clients.

  • Strong analytical skills: you use ticket, SLA and adoption data to make decisions and influence peers.

  • Experience running a pooled or follow-the-sun support model.

  • Experience building or running a customer education program or Help Center.

  • Comfort using AI tools to improve team efficiency, reporting and client communications.

  • Clear, calm communication with executives, both internal and client-side.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in retail media, commerce media or programmatic advertising, and familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, Criteo or DV360.

About Vantage
Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. With a global presence in North America and Asia-Pacific, Vantage enables retailers to launch and grow their media networks through scalable technology and automated workflows, and is trusted by leading retailers like The Home Depot to power their retail media programs.

For a closer look at what we do, our culture, and our benefits, check out our about us and careers pages.

Remote-First, Based in Toronto
Vantage is proudly headquartered in Toronto, but we’re a remote-first team spread across North America (and beyond). Our flexible work philosophy means team members can thrive from wherever they do their best work—whether that’s from a home office, a local café, or while adding stamps to their passport. With a remote-friendly setup, home office support, and annual company retreats, we stay connected, collaborative, and energized—no matter the time zone.

Vantage’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Vantage Analytics is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment. We encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.

We promote equality and strive to provide all current and prospective employees with support and opportunities. Reasonable accommodations are available to job applicants on request and throughout the application process.

How Vantage Uses AI in the Recruitment Process

At Vantage, we use AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. This may include using AI to help organize, screen, and assess applications. We are committed to using these tools responsibly, and ensuring every candidate is treated fairly throughout the process.

All hiring decisions at Vantage are made by our team. Who we invite to work at Vantage is a decision we only trust ourselves to make.

What's Next?
We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of the final stages of our hiring process, all candidates will be required to successfully complete a criminal background check.
